cases.sentence: ___ тем временем потянулся к графинчику и, покосившись на Барменталя, налил рюмочку
options: Шариков
Шарикова
Шарикову
Шариковым
cases.translation: Sharikov meanwhile reached for the little decanter and, glancing sideways at Bormenthal, poured himself a shot.
cases.explain: «Шариков потянулся» — Sharikov is the subject performing the action, so his name stands in the Nominative.

cases.sentence: Шариков длинно вздохнул и стал ловить куски ___ в густом соусе
options: осетрина
осетрины
осетрине
осетриной
cases.translation: Sharikov sighed heavily and began fishing pieces of sturgeon out of the thick sauce.
cases.explain: «Куски (чего?) осетрины» — the whole from which pieces are taken is expressed by the Genitive, so осетрина becomes осетрины.

cases.sentence: Наконец отложил сигару в пепельницу, подошел к ___, сплошь состоящему из стекла
options: шкаф
шкафа
шкафу
шкафом
cases.translation: Finally he set the cigar down in the ashtray and walked over to the cabinet, made entirely of glass.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (up to/toward) governs the Dative case, so шкаф becomes шкафу.

options: банка
банки
банке
банку
cases.translation: Filipp Filippovich took out a narrow jar.
cases.explain: The transitive verb «вынул» (took out) takes a direct object in the Accusative, so банка becomes банку.

cases.sentence: Барменталь остановил на полдороги вилку с ___ белого мяса
options: кусок
куска
куску
куском
cases.translation: Bormenthal froze mid-motion with his fork holding a piece of white meat.
cases.explain: The preposition «с» meaning "with" governs the Instrumental case, so кусок becomes куском.

cases.sentence: В ___ нежно звенел под пальцами Филиппа Филипповича репетир в карманчике
options: кабинет
кабинета
кабинету
кабинете
cases.translation: In the study, the little pocket repeater watch chimed softly under Filipp Filippovich's fingers.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» expressing location governs the Prepositional case, so кабинет becomes кабинете.

reading.ru: «Нет, нет и нет», – настойчиво заговорил Барменталь.
reading.question: How does Bormenthal open this scene at dinner?
options: By insistently refusing something, saying 'No, no, and no'
By offering Sharikov more wine
By announcing he is leaving
By praising Sharikov's manners
reading.correct: By insistently refusing something, saying 'No, no, and no'
reading.explain: Bormenthal begins insistently with 'No, no, and no,' refusing to let Sharikov eat until he tucks in his napkin.

reading.ru: Левой рукой он заслонил блюдо от Зины, а правой запихнул салфетку за воротник и стал похож на клиента парикмахерской.
reading.question: What does Sharikov do with his hands when told to tuck in his napkin?
options: He shields the dish with one hand and tucks the napkin into his collar with the other, looking like a barbershop customer
He throws the napkin on the floor
He refuses to touch the napkin at all
He hands the napkin to Zina
reading.correct: He shields the dish with one hand and tucks the napkin into his collar with the other, looking like a barbershop customer
reading.explain: With his left hand he shields the dish from Zina, and with his right he stuffs the napkin behind his collar, looking like a customer at a barber's.

reading.ru: Вы последнее время слишком налегаете на водку».
reading.question: What warning does Bormenthal give Sharikov about his drinking?
options: That he has been drinking too much vodka lately
That vodka is completely forbidden in the house
That he must switch to wine only
That the professor will cut off his allowance
reading.correct: That he has been drinking too much vodka lately
reading.explain: Bormenthal warns Sharikov that he has been leaning too heavily on vodka recently.

reading.ru: Шариков тем временем потянулся к графинчику и, покосившись на Барменталя, налил рюмочку.
reading.question: What does Sharikov do while the others are talking?
options: He reaches for the decanter and pours himself a shot while glancing at Bormenthal
He leaves the table
He starts singing loudly
He offers to pour drinks for everyone first
reading.correct: He reaches for the decanter and pours himself a shot while glancing at Bormenthal
reading.explain: Sharikov reaches for the little decanter and, glancing sideways at Bormenthal, pours himself a shot glass.

reading.ru: Шариков выплеснул содержимое рюмки себе в глотку, сморчился, кусочек хлеба поднес к носу, понюхал, а затем проглотил.
reading.question: How does Sharikov drink his vodka and eat the accompanying bread?
options: He throws the shot down his throat, grimaces, then sniffs a piece of bread before swallowing it
He sips it slowly like wine
He refuses the bread entirely
He shares the shot with Bormenthal
reading.correct: He throws the shot down his throat, grimaces, then sniffs a piece of bread before swallowing it
reading.explain: Sharikov throws the vodka down his throat, grimaces, and instead of eating the bread normally, sniffs it before swallowing it, an odd habit.

reading.ru: «Виноват?» «Стаж!» – повторил Филипп Филиппович и горько качнул головой.
reading.question: What single word does Filipp Filippovich repeat bitterly, confusing Bormenthal?
options: 'Stazh' (length of service/criminal record)
'Vodka'
'Klim'
'Professor'
reading.correct: 'Stazh' (length of service/criminal record)
reading.explain: Filipp Filippovich repeats the word 'stazh' bitterly, shaking his head, hinting at Sharikov's inherited criminal past from Chugunkin.

reading.ru: Его глаза прояснились, он благосклоннее поглядывал на Шарикова, черная голова которого в салфетке сидела как муха в сметане.
reading.question: How does Filipp Filippovich's mood change after drinking wine, and how is Sharikov's appearance described?
options: His mood softens, and Sharikov's dark head in the napkin looks like a fly in sour cream
He becomes angrier and glares at Sharikov
He falls asleep at the table
He leaves the table abruptly
reading.correct: His mood softens, and Sharikov's dark head in the napkin looks like a fly in sour cream
reading.explain: After the wine, his eyes clear and he looks more kindly at Sharikov, whose dark head in a white napkin resembles 'a fly in sour cream.'

reading.ru: «В театр я не пойду», – неприязненно отозвался Шариков и перекрестил рот.
reading.question: How does Sharikov respond to the suggestion of going to the theater?
options: He hostilely refuses, saying he won't go to the theater
He eagerly agrees to go
He asks to go to the opera instead
He says he has already been many times
reading.correct: He hostilely refuses, saying he won't go to the theater
reading.explain: Sharikov responds with hostility that he will not go to the theater, crossing his mouth as he speaks.

reading.ru: Что же вы читаете?» В голове у него вдруг мелькнула картина.
reading.question: What image suddenly flashes through Sharikov's mind when asked what he reads?
options: A desert island, a palm tree, and a man in animal skins and a cap (Robinson Crusoe)
A picture of the circus
An image of Filipp Filippovich as a boy
A blank, since he thinks of nothing
reading.correct: A desert island, a palm tree, and a man in animal skins and a cap (Robinson Crusoe)
reading.explain: When asked what he reads, an image of a desert island, a palm tree, and a man in animal skins flashes through his mind — Robinson Crusoe.

reading.ru: Барменталь остановил на полдороги вилку с куском белого мяса, а Филипп Филиппович расплескал вино.
reading.question: How do Bormenthal and Filipp Filippovich react to what Sharikov says he is actually reading?
options: Bormenthal freezes with his fork mid-air, and Filipp Filippovich spills his wine
They both burst out laughing
They ignore him and continue eating
They congratulate him on his choice
reading.correct: Bormenthal freezes with his fork mid-air, and Filipp Filippovich spills his wine
reading.explain: Startled by Sharikov's answer (the correspondence of Engels and Kautsky), Bormenthal stops his fork mid-motion and Filipp Filippovich spills his wine.

reading.ru: А то что ж, один в семи комнатах расселился, штанов у него сорок пар, а другой шляется, в сорных ящиках питание ищет».
reading.question: What social critique does Sharikov make, clearly aimed at Filipp Filippovich?
options: That one man lives spread out in seven rooms with forty pairs of trousers while another wanders looking for food in trash bins
That doctors are paid too little
That the circus should be free for everyone
That women should not attend university
reading.correct: That one man lives spread out in seven rooms with forty pairs of trousers while another wanders looking for food in trash bins
reading.explain: Sharikov complains that one man sprawls in seven rooms with forty pairs of trousers while another scrounges for food in garbage bins — a clear jab at the professor.

reading.ru: «За кран и за кота!» – ряхнул друг Филипп Филиппович, выходя из состояния иронического спокойствия.
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich say the 130 rubles he demands from Sharikov are for?
options: For the broken faucet and the cat incident
For new clothes he bought him
For his share of the rent
For medical treatment
reading.correct: For the broken faucet and the cat incident
reading.explain: Breaking his ironic calm, Filipp Filippovich snaps that the money is 'for the tap and for the cat,' referring to the flood and chase.

reading.ru: «Вы стоите на самой низшей ступени развития», – перекричал Филипп Филиппович.
reading.question: How does Filipp Filippovich characterize Sharikov's level of development in his tirade?
options: As standing on the very lowest rung of development
As surprisingly advanced for his age
As equal to any educated man
As beyond hope of any judgment
reading.correct: As standing on the very lowest rung of development
reading.explain: Shouting over him, Filipp Filippovich declares that Sharikov stands on the very lowest rung of development.

reading.ru: «Все у вас негодяи», – испуганно ответил Шариков, оглушенный нападением с двух сторон.
reading.question: How does Sharikov respond when Preobrazhensky and Bormenthal both attack him verbally at once?
options: Frightened, he says everyone around them is a scoundrel
He calmly agrees with everything they say
He storms out of the room
He starts crying uncontrollably
reading.correct: Frightened, he says everyone around them is a scoundrel
reading.explain: Stunned by the attack from both men, Sharikov answers fearfully that, in their view, 'everyone is a scoundrel.'

reading.ru: Я бы этого швонзера повесил, честное слово, на первом суку, воскликнул Филипп Филиппович, яростно впиваясь в крыло индюшки.
reading.question: What violent wish does Filipp Filippovich express about Shvonder while eating turkey?
options: That he would hang Shvonder from the first tree branch he found
That he would report Shvonder to the police
That he would simply ignore Shvonder forever
That he would invite Shvonder to dinner to reason with him
reading.correct: That he would hang Shvonder from the first tree branch he found
reading.explain: Furiously tearing into a turkey wing, Filipp Filippovich exclaims he would hang that 'Shvonder' from the very first branch.

reading.ru: Зина внесла на круглом блюде рыжую с правого и румяную с левого бока бабу и кофейник.
reading.question: What dessert does Zina bring in on a round plate?
options: A baba cake, golden on one side and rosy on the other, with a coffee pot
A plate of fruit
Ice cream
Nothing; dinner ends without dessert
reading.correct: A baba cake, golden on one side and rosy on the other, with a coffee pot
reading.explain: Zina brings in a round dish holding a baba cake, golden-brown on one side and rosy on the other, along with the coffee pot.

reading.ru: Откушав кофе, Филипп Филиппович поглядел на часы, нажал на репетир, и они проиграли нежно восемь с четвертью.
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich do with his pocket watch after finishing his coffee?
options: He presses the repeater mechanism, which chimes a quarter past eight
He winds it and puts it away without checking the time
He gives it to Sharikov as a gift
He discovers it is broken
reading.correct: He presses the repeater mechanism, which chimes a quarter past eight
reading.explain: After his coffee, he checks his watch and presses the chiming mechanism, which softly plays out a quarter past eight.

reading.ru: У Соломонского, начал вычитывать Барменталь, четыре какие-то юссамс и человек мертвой точки.
reading.question: What act does Bormenthal read about at the Solomonsky circus?
options: Four performers called 'yussams' and a 'man of the dead point' act
A famous lion tamer
A magician show
Trained dogs performing tricks
reading.correct: Four performers called 'yussams' and a 'man of the dead point' act
reading.explain: Reading from the newspaper listing, Bormenthal mentions four mysterious 'yussams' and a 'man of the dead point' performing at Solomonsky's.

reading.ru: Слоны – животные полезные», – ответил Шариков.
reading.question: What is Sharikov's opinion of elephants at the circus?
options: That elephants are useful animals
That elephants are dangerous and should be banned
That elephants are boring to watch
That elephants are just like cats
reading.correct: That elephants are useful animals
reading.explain: Sharikov answers that, unlike cats, elephants are 'useful animals,' showing his odd practical logic.

reading.ru: Через десять минут Иван Арнольдович, и Шариков, одетый в кепку с утиным носом, и драповое пальто с поднятым воротником, уехали в цирк.
reading.question: What does Sharikov wear as he leaves for the circus?
options: A duck-billed cap and a heavy woolen coat with the collar turned up
A tuxedo and top hat
The professor's own fur coat
Nothing warm at all, despite the cold
reading.correct: A duck-billed cap and a heavy woolen coat with the collar turned up
reading.explain: Ten minutes later, Ivan Arnoldovich and Sharikov, dressed in a duck-billed cap and a heavy coat with a raised collar, leave for the circus.

reading.ru: Из шкафа с третьей стеклянной полки Филипп Филиппович вынул узкую банку и стал, нахмурившись, рассматривать ее на свет огней.
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich take out of the glass cabinet once alone in his study?
options: A narrow jar, which he examines frowning in the light
A bottle of wine
A stack of old letters
A weapon
reading.correct: A narrow jar, which he examines frowning in the light
reading.explain: From the third glass shelf of the cabinet, he takes out a narrow jar and, frowning, examines it in the light.

reading.ru: В прозрачной и тяжкой жидкости плавал, не падая на дно, малый беленький комочек, извлеченный из недр шарикового мозга.
reading.question: What is floating inside the jar Filipp Filippovich examines?
options: A small white lump taken from deep within Sharik's brain
A preserved insect
A ring
A small note
reading.correct: A small white lump taken from deep within Sharik's brain
reading.explain: Suspended in the thick, clear liquid, without sinking, floats a small white lump extracted from the depths of Sharik's brain — the original pituitary gland.

reading.ru: Он долго палил вторую сигару, совершенно изживав ее конец, и, наконец, в полном одиночестве, зеленоокрашенный, как седой фауст, воскликнул «Ей-богу, я, кажется, решусь».
reading.question: What does Filipp Filippovich finally decide, alone in his study at the end of the chapter?
options: That he will, it seems, finally resolve to act (implying reversing the operation)
That he will retire from medicine entirely
That he will hand Sharikov over to Shvonder
That he will leave Moscow forever
reading.correct: That he will, it seems, finally resolve to act (implying reversing the operation)
reading.explain: Alone and green-tinted like an aged Faust, he finally exclaims that he thinks he will indeed resolve to do something drastic.

reading.ru: Профессор нетерпеливо ждал возвращения доктора Барменталя и Шарикова из цирка.
reading.question: How does the chapter end?
options: With the professor impatiently waiting for Bormenthal and Sharikov to return from the circus
With Sharikov's arrest
With a party celebrating the professor's discovery
With Zina announcing dinner is ready
reading.correct: With the professor impatiently waiting for Bormenthal and Sharikov to return from the circus
reading.explain: The chapter closes with the professor impatiently awaiting the return of Doctor Bormenthal and Sharikov from the circus.
